text: 1935 removes doHelpButton and its old Suite openHelp comment from the shared FilterEditor script. The accepted dialog exposes accept and cancel, and its script registers dialogaccept to onAccept. This is a narrow retirement of an unused bridge; it does not establish a project-wide ban on help or authorize removing unrelated help controls. Retain exact current control wiring when assessing whether a deleted helper had a user-facing action. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: The retired FilterEditor help bridge is not a current dialog action
